title: ULLVIDE flat sheet
description: ULLVIDE flat sheet, light pink, King The cool and crisp percale quality is densely woven with a high thread count from cotton and lyocell. The material breathes, absorbs moisture, is resistant to pilling – and feels irresistibly soft. Just as easy to put on as to remove and machine wash.
features: Thread count indicates the number of threads per square inch of fabric. The higher the thread count the more densely woven the fabric.
